title: Seeing Double
synopsis:
Seo-woo reunites with Ra-on, the crush from his school days. Because of his shy nature, he asks his twin brother, Jae-woo, to step in and flirt on his behalf.

However, Jae-woo—who initially had no interest—finds himself falling for Ra-on before he knows it...

A sizzling love triangle born from a sweet, unrequited crush.

Who will ultimately win Ra-on's heart?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
